committee: Call to Session - Speaker Frank Blas Jr.
title: Håfa Adai, I Liheslaturan Guåhan will be called into Session on Tuesday, May 5, 2025, at 9: 00 a.m. in the Speaker Antonio R., Unpingco Legislative Session Hall in the Guam Congress Building for the purpose of conducting State Memorial Services for the late Honorable Luis Herrero, former Mayor of Tamuning. State services will begin promptly at 10:00 a.m. The session will be broadcast on GTA Channel 21, Docomo Channel 117 or 112-4 and at http://www.guamlegislature.gov/live_feed.htm.
